info.name: School Management - Transport APK API
info.description:
Transport APK backend — driver / conductor / transport-manager operational app. 5 bottom-nav tabs: Home · Trips · Students · Alerts · Profile (+ 🔔 top-right).

APK routes are under /school-portal/transport-app/* (the existing school-admin transport management keeps /school-portal/transport/*). Login: POST /school-portal/auth/transport-login. Single 7-day JWT (no refresh). Collection-level Bearer {{accessToken}}; manager-only requests carry {{managerToken}}.

RUN ORDER: "00 - Environment / Health" → "01 - Auth / Login (transport)" (stores accessToken/staffId/schoolId/vehicleId/routeId/stopId) → "📱 Tab 1 · Home / Dashboard" (stores tripId) → walk Tab 2 top-to-bottom (Inspection → Start → Arrive → Board → Depart → Complete).
